mapper.select: SELECT s.*, ii.name as inspect_item_name, ii.code as inspect_item_code FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 and s.discarded = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time ASC

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) AS orderEndTime, s.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, s.quantity, s.plan_quantity AS planQuantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, io.finished, io.create_time AS inspectionRequestTime, io.create_by AS inspectionRequestBy, s.sampled, s.received, s.recycled, s.processed, CASE WHEN s.processed = 1 THEN 3 WHEN s.recycled = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS status, s.recycled_time AS recycledTime, s.recycled_by AS recycledBy, s.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, s.recycle_unit_id AS recycleUnitId, s.recycle_remark AS recycleRemark, s.process_time AS processTime, s.process_by AS processBy, s.process_method AS processMethod, s.process_remark AS processRemark, s.sampler_name AS samplerName, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_name AS receiverName, s.receive_time AS receiveTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.sample_no = #{sampleNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) AS orderEndTime, s.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, s.quantity, s.plan_quantity AS planQuantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, io.finished, io.create_time AS inspectionRequestTime, io.create_by AS inspectionRequestBy, s.sampled, s.received, s.recycled, s.processed, CASE WHEN s.processed = 1 THEN 3 WHEN s.recycled = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS status, s.recycled_time AS recycledTime, s.recycled_by AS recycledBy, s.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, s.recycle_unit_id AS recycleUnitId, s.recycle_remark AS recycleRemark, s.process_time AS processTime, s.process_by AS processBy, s.process_method AS processMethod, s.process_remark AS processRemark, s.sampler_name AS samplerName, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_name AS receiverName, s.receive_time AS receiveTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.sample_no = #{sampleNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time, io.sample_audit_time) AS orderEndTime, s.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, s.quantity, s.plan_quantity AS planQuantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, io.create_time AS inspectionRequestTime, io.create_by AS inspectionRequestBy, s.sampled, s.received, s.recycled, s.processed, CASE WHEN s.processed = 1 THEN 3 WHEN s.recycled = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS status, s.recycled_time AS recycledTime, s.recycled_by AS recycledBy, s.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, s.recycle_unit_id AS recycleUnitId, s.recycle_remark AS recycleRemark, s.process_time AS processTime, s.process_by AS processBy, s.process_method AS processMethod, s.process_remark AS processRemark, s.sampler_name AS samplerName, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_name AS receiverName, s.receive_time AS receiveTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.id = #{sampleId} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, s.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.name AS inspectItemName, s.quantity, s.plan_quantity AS planQuantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, io.create_time AS inspectionRequestTime, io.create_by AS inspectionRequestBy, s.sampled, s.received, s.recycled, s.processed, s.recycled_time AS recycledTime, s.recycled_by AS recycledBy, s.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, s.recycle_unit_id AS recycleUnitId, s.recycle_remark AS recycleRemark, s.process_time AS processTime, s.process_by AS processBy, s.process_method AS processMethod, s.process_remark AS processRemark, s.sampler_name AS samplerName, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_name AS receiverName, s.receive_time AS receiveTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND s.discarded = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time ASC

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, io.material_id AS materialId, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) AS orderEndTime, s.plan_quantity AS planQuantity, s.quantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, s.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, s.recycle_unit_id AS recycleUnitId, s.recycled_time AS recycledTime, s.process_method AS processMethod, s.process_time AS processTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted, CASE WHEN s.processed = 1 THEN 3 WHEN s.recycled = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS status FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.received = 1 AND ( io.order_status = 'TERMINATED' OR io.finished = 1 OR io.order_status = 'COMPLETED' )
AND io.material_id IN
#{item}
AND io.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND s.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) >= #{endTimeStart}
AND COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) <= #{endTimeEnd}
AND (s.recycled = 0 AND s.processed = 0)
AND (s.recycled = 1 AND s.processed = 0)
AND s.processed = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(io.finished_time, io.terminate_time) DESC

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, s.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS orderNo, s.inspect_item_id AS inspectItemId, ii.code AS inspectItemCode, ii.name AS inspectItemName, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, s.quantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, s.sampler_id AS samplerId, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_id AS receiverId, s.receive_time AS receiveTime, io.create_time AS requestTime, io.create_by AS requestUserId, s.create_time AS createTime, s.tag_printed AS tagPrinted FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON s.inspect_item_id = ii.id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.sampled = 1 AND s.received = 0 AND s.discarded = 0
AND s.inspect_item_id = 2000000000000000001
AND s.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND io.material_id IN
#{item}
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
ORDER BY s.sampling_time DESC, s.sample_no ASC

SELECT s.id, s.sample_no AS sampleNo, io.batch_no AS batchNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, s.quantity, s.current_quantity AS currentQuantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, s.receive_time AS retentionTime, s.receiver_id AS retentionUserId, s.retention_expiry_date AS retentionExpiryDate, s.storage_location AS storageLocation, s.received, s.destroyed,
CASE WHEN s.retention_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > s.retention_expiry_date AND s.destroyed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS toBeDestroyed FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.discarded = 0
AND s.inspect_item_id = 2000000000000000001
AND s.received = 1 AND s.destroyed = 0 AND (s.retention_expiry_date IS NULL OR CURDATE() <= s.retention_expiry_date)
AND s.received = 1 AND s.destroyed = 0 AND s.retention_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > s.retention_expiry_date
AND s.destroyed = 1
AND (s.received = 1 OR s.destroyed = 1)
AND s.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND io.material_id IN
#{item}
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
ORDER BY s.receive_time DESC, s.sample_no ASC

SELECT s.sample_no AS sampleNo, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, io.batch_no AS batchNo, s.current_quantity AS quantity, s.unit_id AS unitId, s.sampling_time AS samplingTime, s.receiver_id AS receiverId, s.receive_time AS retentionTime, s.retention_expiry_date AS retentionExpiryDate, s.storage_location AS storageLocation FROM lm_sample s LEFT JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON s.inspection_order_id = io.id LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE s.sample_no = #{sampleNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.inspect_item_id = 2000000000000000001
